headline: GTA Online
subtitle: Brand Wars Event
content:
Proclaim your loyalty to the iconic industries fighting for control of Southern San Andreas’ hearts and minds in the Brand Wars Event, spanning the next two weeks in GTA Online.

This trademark turf war takes place across a selection of incentivized Odd Jobs, Freemode Events, and sponsored Hotring Circuit Series Races. Assist friendly faces making deliveries and sabotage your rivals to show everyone who really owns Los Santos.
